maria.gonzalez: Heads-up — when onboarding the new quantized-1.2 model I noticed the eval traces show a new field `sensitive_labels` with a different shape. our dashboards are blowing up with parsing errors :grimacing:
asad.k: ugh. what changed exactly?
maria.gonzalez: before it was a list of strings like `[\"phone\", \"email\"]`. new model emits `{\"phone\": true, \"email\": false}` (map<string,bool>) because inference output now flags per-label confidence thresholds.
kevin.p: that explains the aggregator failures — the trace ingest lambda expects an array and calls `.map`. CI job failed earlier, saw it in the smoke tests.
ci-bot: CI Failed — eval-harness/integration (run #452) — https://ci.redwood-infra/internal/452 — error: TypeError: sensitive_labels.map is not a function
eva.li: can we make the ingest tolerant? quick fix: accept both shapes and normalize to canonical array in the runner before upload.
jon.park: +1. I can draft a tiny shim in eval-runner that does: `if (Array.isArray(x)) return x; return Object.keys(x).filter(k => x[k])`
kevin.p: also need to patch the dashboard metric pipeline — some mysql ETL expects a CSV in `per_sample_meta` and will explode if rows contain JSON objects.
maria.gonzalez: timeline: hotfix to runner today, then a migration job to normalize historical traces for the new model only. we should avoid touching older models.
asad.k: storage concern: the new traces are slightly larger (map vs array) and our S3 lifecycle + gzip heuristics triggered for multipart threshold — saw a couple uploads fail with 413 during large-run quantization tests. infra-bot logged retries.
infra-bot: S3 uploader: multipart threshold exceeded -> retried 3 times, last status 413. See upload id: abc123
jon.park: we should add a content-size check and fallback to single-part gzip for small deviations. Also surface a warning in the runner logs when shape != expected to monitor adoption rate.
eva.li: for the dashboard, I can add a parser step in the ETL to accept both shapes and write a canonical `sensitive_labels_array` column. will couple this with a small schema version tag in trace metadata.
kevin.p: question: do we want to require model onboarding docs to declare schema changes? maybe add a checklist item: "per-sample metadata shape/version"
maria.gonzalez: yes — add to onboarding checklist + bump eval harness CI to run a schema-lint job that verifies all sample metadata keys are stable or versioned.
ci-bot: New job queued — eval-schema-lint (pr #1204)
asad.k: quick deploy plan: (1) patch runner to normalize on write (2) run migration job for new-model traces only (3) add ETL tolerant parser + small db migration (4) add onboarding checklist + CI lint. estimate 4-6 hours for hotfix + tests.
maria.gonzalez: I'll own (1) and (2). jon, eva — can you pair on (3)?
jon.park: yep, I'll pair with eva this afternoon.
kevin.p: tagging product: we should notify product that eval dashboards will show a transient spike in "sensitive label" counts while we backfill.
maria.gonzalez: noted. tagging @product-notify in the release notes.
eva.li: leaving a sample normalization snippet here for the runner: ```js
function normalizeSensitiveLabels(x){
  if (!x) return [];
  if (Array.isArray(x)) return x;
  return Object.entries(x).filter(([,v])=>v).map(([k])=>k);
}
```
kevin.p: looks good. add unit tests for map/array/null.
infra-bot: Info: S3 uploader adjusted to single-part for content-length < 5MB.
ci-bot: CI Passed — eval-harness/unit (run #453)
maria.gonzalez: great work y'all. once hotfix is live I'll kick the backfill and monitor dashboard. will post an update when done. :thumbsup:
